headline: Real Clients.
subtext: We've helped restaurants across Dubai achieve full municipality compliance — here are two examples of what that looks like in practice.

cases.label: Case Study 01
cases.challenge: 4 active outlets with no formal DM Check system — leaving the group exposed to municipality inspection failures and potential penalties.
cases.approach: Full readiness assessment, platform configuration per outlet workflow, PIC and food handler training, 1-month follow-up support across all locations.
cases.outcome: All 4 outlets fully registered and operational on DM Check — with trained staff achieving complete municipality compliance and inspection readiness.

cases.label: Case Study 02
cases.challenge: No structured food safety documentation, no GMP system — creating significant compliance risk and inconsistent hygiene practices across kitchen staff.
cases.approach: Full premises GAP report, 16 SOPs developed covering all food safety operations, allergen management protocols, and complete HACCP pre-requisite documentation.
cases.outcome: Ongoing monthly audits, corrective action tracking, supplier evaluation, and continuous staff training maintaining consistent compliance with Dubai Food Code 2020.
